response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink AS orderslink,
    o.ordertune AS order_type,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_group_rebate
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.order_type,
  g.avg_rebate,
  g.avg_relative_gap,
  g.avg_rebate - b.avg_group_rebate AS excess_over_baseline
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.avg_group_rebate
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL fee rate produce a NULL relative gap and are excluded from that group's AVG; a zero fee rate also yields NULL for the division in SQLite. The rebate baseline averages all matched groups' average rebates, including groups whose rebate is NULL only insofar as AVG ignores those NULL values.
